denyCommands.description: extra shell commands to block: { "<rule name>": "<regular expression>" }, added to the built-in rules; set a built-in rule's name to null to turn it off

allowedHosts.description: hosts the agent may send requests to (a host also allows its subdomains); empty means any host

confineWrites.description: file tools may only change files inside the working directory and the system temp directory

secretFiles.description: file names (regular expressions) that no tool may read or change, so they never reach the model
